title: Matrix Reprogrammed Structured Investigation Schema
description: A lightweight public-record entity and relationship model aligned with FollowTheMoney concepts where practical.
evidenceBoundary: A structured entity or relationship records what a cited source states or what an automated parser observed. It does not convert association, mention, office, proximity, wealth, a photograph, a flight entry, an allegation or an unauthenticated leak into guilt.

Person.description: A natural person named in a public record.

Organization.description: A non-person institution that does not fit a narrower type.

GovernmentAgency.description: A government department, regulator, inspector-general office, court, committee or public authority.

Contractor.description: A company identified in a procurement or public-contract context.

Trust.description: A trust or comparable legal arrangement.

Contract.description: A procurement award, grant, agreement or contract record.

Payment.description: A documented transfer, award amount, fine, penalty, settlement or other money event.

Sanction.description: An official sanction, debarment, restriction or enforcement designation.

CourtCase.description: A court, tribunal, complaint, indictment, judgment or docket record.

Investigation.description: An official or published investigation, audit, inquiry or enforcement matter.

Document.description: A hash-preserved source document or disclosure record.

Finding.description: An evidence-bounded conclusion or record update generated by the investigation machine.

MissingRecord.description: A missing, removed, unavailable, changed or unresolved record observation.

Source.description: A registered public source platform or archive.

LegalAuthority.description: A statute, rule, order, jurisdiction or delegated authority.

Decision.description: A judgment, award, vote, approval, denial or other documented decision.

PublicGroup.description: A population, community, market or public body affected by a documented decision.

relationshipTypes.published: A source published or hosts a finding or document.
relationshipTypes.operatedBy: A registered source platform is operated, maintained or published by an identified organisation or public body.
relationshipTypes.retrievedFrom: A document was retrieved from a registered source.
relationshipTypes.supports: A cited document directly supports a finding within the stated evidence boundary.
relationshipTypes.mentions: A source record names an entity without establishing wrongdoing or a substantive relationship.
relationshipTypes.subjectOf: An entity is the stated subject of a finding, case, sanction, investigation or document.
relationshipTypes.affiliatedWith: A source record states an affiliation, role or membership.
relationshipTypes.owns: A cited record states an ownership relationship.
relationshipTypes.contractsWith: A cited record states a contractual relationship.
relationshipTypes.awardedTo: A cited procurement record identifies an award recipient.
relationshipTypes.paid: A cited record identifies a payment or transfer route.
relationshipTypes.sanctioned: An official record identifies a sanctioned entity.
relationshipTypes.partyTo: A cited court record identifies a party to a case.
relationshipTypes.investigates: A cited record identifies an investigator and subject.
relationshipTypes.governedBy: A record or decision cites a legal authority.
relationshipTypes.decided: A public body or court made a documented decision.
relationshipTypes.affects: A documented decision or mechanism identifies an affected public group.
relationshipTypes.overseenBy: A record identifies an oversight or supervisory body.
relationshipTypes.missingFrom: A record was observed as missing, removed or unavailable from a source.
relationshipTypes.changedAt: A source-change observation records a changed public source.
relationshipTypes.reportedTransaction: An authenticated ownership filing reports a coded transaction between a reporting person and an issuer security.
relationshipTypes.reportedPositionChange: Consecutive authenticated institutional filings support a change between reported quarter-end positions.
relationshipTypes.relatedTo: A neutral relationship used only when the available record does not support a narrower type.

gradeDefinitions.A: Final official record, judgment, conviction, guilty plea, regulator order or authenticated primary record.
gradeDefinitions.B: Official charge, complaint, audit, inspector-general report, government filing or strong primary documentation.
gradeDefinitions.C: Credible journalism, authenticated archive material or corroborated document lead.
gradeDefinitions.D: Unverified claim, speculation, anonymous allegation or unauthenticated leak.
